title: kernel.settings.confirm@1 (decision kind, floor local, safety grant): bound args
description: Apply settings a session sent that the service did not write without the person (inventory K11, H6, H7, W3). During the overlap the args are the v2 Inbox item as it was shown (its text by ref) and the v2 action each option runs; the bind re-checks the live item at claim. Preview rows, in order: Who, Project, Effect, Note, Details {digest, ref, bytes}. Options: approve 'Apply' (local), decline 'Keep mine' (narrow). A kernel request may bind one setting by key instead (no text).

key.description: The one setting a kernel request binds (keys for several are in the item text)
